question: Quels covenants n'ont pas été respectés au deuxième trimestre 2025 ?

FROM covenants AS c 
WHERE norm(c.trimestre) = norm('2025-T2') AND norm(c.respecte) = norm('Non') LIMIT 200

question: Quels clients ont un covenant dépassé au T2 2025 ?
sql_agent: SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id FROM clients AS c JOIN credits AS cr ON cr.client_id = c.client_id JOIN covenants AS cov ON cov.credit_id = cr.credit_id WHERE norm(cov.trimestre) = norm('2025-T2') AND norm(cov.respecte) = norm('Non') LIMIT 200
sql_reference: SELECT DISTINCT cr.client_id FROM covenants cv JOIN credits cr ON cr.credit_id = cv.credit_id WHERE cv.respecte = 'Non' AND cv.trimestre = '2025-T2'
